subject: general
question: The State Election Commission does NOT conduct elections to ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**State Legislative Assemblies**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The State Election Commission is responsible for conducting elections to local bodies such as **Gram Panchayats, Municipal Corporations, and Town Municipal Councils**.
 
• However, elections to **State Legislative Assemblies** are conducted by the **Election Commission of India**.
 
• The State Election Commission operates at the state level, whereas the Election Commission of India is a federal authority.
 
• This distinction ensures that local and state elections are managed by specialized bodies suited to their respective scopes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **State Election Commission** was constituted under the provisions of the **73rd and 74th Amendments** to the Constitution of India.
 
• The **Election Commission of India** was established on **25th January 1950** and is responsible for administering elections to the Parliament, State Legislatures, and the offices of the President and Vice-President in India.
 
• The **73rd Amendment** pertains to the Panchayati Raj Institutions (rural local governments), while the **74th Amendment** pertains to Municipalities (urban local governments).
 
• Both commissions play a crucial role in ensuring free and fair elections in their respective domains.
 
• The **Constitution of India** provides the framework for the division of responsibilities between these electoral bodies.
